caption: A large, clear balloon is inflated with air, showing the internal pressure causing the balloon to stretch.
relations: Air is pumped into the balloon, increasing internal pressure that pushes outward on the balloon's elastic surface.
The balloon's material stretches uniformly in response to the growing pressure, expanding its volume.
As the balloon expands, the stretched surface resists further deformation, balancing the internal pressure.
The visible bulging of the balloon's shape demonstrates the direct physical effect of internal pressure on its elastic walls.
